_doc: Owned per-state wear weights (wear.py), the Second Wind's scale: 0 = none, 1 = its derelict ceiling. The Colossus Mk.III, a pirate prize ship: `service` is the Colossus's own row (an old hauler still in work); `battle` is what the build ships, service plus fighting and pirate upkeep, near the sibling pirate hulls (Kite (P) and Hound (P) `pirate`, Wolf (P) `battle`): scuffed and pitted, the crimson overpaint faded, heavy grime and soot round six main drives, never properly maintained.
